CustomField.description: The ID of the Org-Wide Email Address that signature emails are sent from (requests, reminders, PIN codes, completion confirmations), unless the template's Brand sets its own. Required: if this is blank and the Brand sets none, signature emails are not sent. When a Microsoft 365 Named Credential is set, requests, reminders and revocations go through Microsoft 365 instead, and this address still sends the rest.
CustomField.label: Signature Org-Wide Email Address ID
